QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Appeasing the Dark God
QuestInfo.0: Nue is furious with Ibaraki. See what Ibaraki has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Perhaps if you help Nue with his confession, he'll agree to be your friend. Do your best!
QuestInfo.2: You asked Nue to prepare a gift and a letter containing his feelings about Takeno Konoko.
